name: meruchat
description: MeruChat — HTML/CSS web chat wrapped with Capacitor (Android/iOS) and Electron (desktop).

scripts.serve: echo "Static dev preview: run  python -m http.server 8911  from this directory, then open http://localhost:8911/"
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run www && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run www && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run www && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run www && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run www && npx cap sync ios

_comment_filesystem: @capacitor/filesystem 为可选依赖（离线缓存等场景），暂无代码引用；如不需要可移除 dependencies 中的该项。详见 docs/packaging.md。
